design.name: Exclude postings that mention words
design.description: Rules out a posting whose title or text mentions any of your words or phrases, such as on-call or travel.

settings.label: Words or phrases
settings.help: Separate them with commas. Matching ignores case and whole words only.

design.behavior: Lower-case the title and description. For each comma-separated phrase in setting1 (trimmed, lower-cased, skipped when empty), if it occurs as a whole word or phrase, answer exclude with the note: mentions "<phrase>". Otherwise pass.
